verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GlitchTip accepts an auth token (SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN) for the CLI and has a CLI login and an MCP server. Nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials, such as per-scope, per-project or read-only tokens for an agent. A generic auth token is an adjacent building block, not the scoped-credential capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
